scope: Evidence-only first-pass proposals for these ten existing identities, awaiting independent full eligibility review and the global candidate freeze.

criteria_evidence.primary: Article pp.1-2 introduces original computational comparison.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Article p.6 Fig.5 and computational-details section identify (110) rutile surfaces.
criteria_evidence.oer: Article title, abstract and reaction sequence pp.1-2.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Article p.2 CHE thermodynamics and overpotential definition; activity volcano Fig.4 p.5.

records.label: Inico 2024

criteria_evidence.primary: Article pp.1-3 describes original comparative DFT calculations.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Title and article pp.1-2 identify TiO2, RuO2 and IrO2 (110).
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: CHE is used for stability analysis on p.3; no explicit study CHE overpotential located in the extracted article text or inspected results/conclusions. This is not a proof of absence.

unresolved: Missing SI could contain the required reported CHE overpotential; do not derive an overpotential from intermediate energies and call it reported.

criteria_evidence.primary: Article p.1 and sections 2-3 describe original computational and experimental study.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Article p.4 describes RuO2(110) surface states; model/phase diagrams in section 3.1.
criteria_evidence.oer: Article p.5 section 3.2 reports four-step OER thermodynamics.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Article p.1 abstract reports thermodynamic overpotentials; section 3.2 p.5 includes electroneutral free-energy/volcano baseline, with SI Table S8 referenced. GC-DFT title does not eliminate this CHE arm.
criteria_evidence.date: Article p.1 explicitly says available online 23 January 2025; preserve Crossref print 2025-03 and absent Crossref online date.

records.label: Gauthier 2017

criteria_evidence.primary: Local proof p.1 abstract describes original solvation calculations.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Title, abstract and section 2 identify IrO2(110).
criteria_evidence.oer: Section 3.3 p.7 and Fig.7 analyze the OER free-energy sequence.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Section 2 describes CHE. Section 3.3 gives step/free-energy information, but no explicit study CHE overpotential located in extracted text or inspected results. A reference to a low-overpotential catalyst is not this study reporting eta.

unresolved: Do not convert a 1.8 eV step to eta by subtracting 1.23 V and treat that as a reported overpotential.
A zero-result Figshare DOI search does not prove no SI exists.

criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Own modeled catalyst family is perovskites: article p.1 abstract, section 3.3 p.6, Fig.5 p.8; SI pp.2-3 and p.9. The rutile title in the reference list is not an own rutile (110) calculation.
criteria_evidence.oer: Article section 3.3 calculates OER on the perovskite family.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: CHE OER overpotential is reported for perovskites; wrong surface family for this population.
criteria_evidence.date: Crossref online 2018-01-08 and print 2018-01-18; local copyright 2017 is not first publication.

additional_evidence_files.identity_evidence: SI p.1 exact title and four authors; main article supporting-information declaration p.10.

records.label: Exner 2020

criteria_evidence.primary: Article is labeled Viewpoint and develops a descriptor; section 5 p.6 reanalyzes a prior 90-catalyst dataset. The label alone is insufficient for exclusion.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: SI pp.S2-S6 analyzes RuO2(110); S10 section 3.1 lists MO2(110), including Ru/Ir/Ti.
criteria_evidence.oer: Article and SI analyze OER energetics and new Gmax(eta) descriptor.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: SI S10 explicitly attributes MO2(110) free energies and eta_TD to earlier sources. Distinguish applied eta used in Gmax(eta) from the registered thermodynamic CHE overpotential.

unresolved: Determine whether the study is qualifying primary computational research under the frozen rule despite reliance on earlier energetics.
Confirm whether the article/SI actually reports the required CHE eta for the qualifying rutile arm; do not substitute applied operating overpotential or Gmax.

additional_evidence_files.identity_evidence: SI p.S1 exact title and sole author Kai S. Exner; Figshare resource DOI match.

criteria_evidence.primary: Article p.1 describes original linear-response DFT+U comparison.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Article p.2 Figure 1 and model description establish rutile (110).
criteria_evidence.oer: Article pp.1-2 reaction sequence and activity analysis.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Article p.2 Eq.12 defines thermodynamic CHE eta; article p.5 Fig.4 reports activity trends.
criteria_evidence.date: Crossref and publisher detailed history online 2015-02-20; print 2015-03-05. Publisher header and author news use 2015-02-09; preserve date discrepancy, all within window.

records.label: Divanis 2020

criteria_evidence.primary: Publisher article HTML section 2.1 reports own one/two-dopant TiO2 calculations in addition to literature synthesis; section 3 discusses them. Perspective wording in the title is not sufficient to exclude.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Publisher HTML sections 2.1 and 3 establish TiO2(110), but an explicit rutile-polymorph statement for the new doped-TiO2 arm was not located. (110) alone does not establish rutile.
criteria_evidence.oer: Article section 3 and retained SI S27 Figure SI-18 show OER energetics for n-type-doped TiO2.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Parent independently rendered SI PDF p.27/S27: Fig.SI-18b has U[V] axis, 1.23 V baseline and an explicit eta_OER arrow for a modeled point. This is reported graphical eta; no numeric value is inferred from the graphic.
criteria_evidence.date: Publisher first published 2020-02-11; Crossref previously provided only year 2020.

unresolved: Establish the rutile polymorph of the new doped-TiO2(110) calculation arm from primary text or unambiguous structural evidence; the facet label alone is insufficient.

visual_evidence.observation: Explicit eta_OER arrow on Fig.SI-18b; no numerical reading adopted.

criteria_evidence.primary: Article p.1 original transition-metal substitution calculations.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Article title and p.1 abstract identify rutile TiO2(110).
criteria_evidence.oer: Article pp.1-2 reaction and energetic model.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Article pp.1-2 computational hydrogen-electrode treatment and eta expression; p.4 Table 1 reports eta.

records.label: Mom 2014

criteria_evidence.primary: Publisher abstract suggests original unrestricted-DFT analysis; article body unavailable.
criteria_evidence.rutile_110: Not established from current article full text because article is unavailable; SI alone does not close this criterion.
criteria_evidence.oer: Article title/abstract and SI free-energy tables establish OER topic.
criteria_evidence.reported_che_overpotential: Not confirmed from accessible article/SI evidence in this bounded review.
criteria_evidence.date: Detailed publisher history and Crossref online 2014-02-11; print 2014-02-27. Header/institution record 2014-02-03 retained as unresolved discrepancy; all within window.

unresolved: Article full-text access remains unresolved; do not turn missing access into exclusion or negative method codes.

review_amendments.correction: Initial proposed inclusion was withdrawn during independent review: new TiO2(110) calculations and graphical CHE eta are evidenced, but the required rutile polymorph remains unestablished. No inclusion had been adopted.
